sih_problem_statement: SIH 26108 - AI-Powered Recommendation Engine for Identifying Applicable Indian Standards (IS Standards) for Procurement Specifications

design_philosophy.core_aesthetic: Apple Design Discipline + BIS Institutional Authority + Subtle Modern Indian Identity
design_philosophy.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY INSTITUTIONAL
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Marry Apple's ultra-refined spacing and typography hierarchy with official Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) government mandate clarity.
Guilloche Integrity: Utilize subtle security/guilloche watermark patterns to evoke sovereign authenticity, standard certification, and document security.
Clear Status System: Standard status indicators must be unmistakable (🟢 Current, 🟡 Under Revision, 🔴 Withdrawn/Superseded).
Explainable AI: Every IS standard recommendation MUST feature evidence-backed reasoning, clause references, parameter mapping, and score breakdown.

primary_bis_red.usage: Primary CTAs, Brand identity accents, BIS emblem framing, key metric highlights

secondary_deep_navy.usage: Headers, primary typography, technical data tables, status badges, structural borders

accent_saffron.usage: Use VERY SPARINGLY — High priority alerts, AI gap analysis callouts, critical clause tags

base_warm_off_white.usage: Main app background, structural canvas, clean reading surfaces

typography.font_family_body: Inter, IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#0B132B]
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#0B132B]

image_urls.description: Engineer performing quality testing and calibration in manufacturing facility
Factory workers operating high precision heavy machinery according to safety standards
Construction engineer auditing structural specifications and safety compliance

application_workflow_steps.name: Institutional Landing Page
components: Header Navigation with BIS Manak Logo, Bureau credentials, and Nav links
Hero Section with Guilloche pattern overlay, live stats ticker (e.g., 22,000+ Active IS Standards indexed, 99.4% Extraction Precision)
Quick Procurement Specification Analyzer Demo Input
Interactive Feature Grid: Automated IS Mapping, Parameter Extraction, Gap & Compliance Analysis, Audit Trail
SIH 2026 Problem Statement 26108 Trust Badge

application_workflow_steps.name: Procurement Intelligence Dashboard
components: Analytics summary metrics (Total Analyses, High Confidence Recommendations, Compliance Rate, Active Standards)
Quick Start Presets (e.g., 'Structural Steel for Bridges', 'Transformers & Electrical Distribution', 'Cement & Concrete Specs', 'Personal Protective Equipment PPE')
Recent Tender Analysis Activity List with status badges & instant re-open
Quick Requirement Dropzone / Direct Text Entry trigger

application_workflow_steps.name: New Procurement Spec Workspace
components: Dual Upload Mode: Rich Text Specification Input OR PDF File Upload Simulation
Pre-loaded Sample Tender Documents dropdown for instant 1-click evaluation (e.g. 'NHAI Highway Guardrail Tender', 'CPWD Concrete Supply Tender', 'Indian Railways Locomotive Cable Specification')
Procurement Context Selectors (Department, Sector: Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/Textiles/Chemical, Budget Scope)
Analyze Tender Spec CTA with loading state triggering processing pipeline

application_workflow_steps.name: AI Analysis Pipeline Stream
components: Step-by-step pipeline visualization: 1. OCR & PDF Text Extraction -> 2. Product & Technical Entity Extraction -> 3. Semantic IS Standard Search -> 4. Clause Evidence Matching & Gap Scoring
Live progress bar with simulated millisecond step triggers and status updates

application_workflow_steps.name: Extracted Technical Breakdown
components: Structured Extraction Cards: Identified Product Category, Intended Scope & Operating Environment, Extracted Key Terms
Technical Parameters Matrix (Parameter Name, Value, Unit, Standard Benchmark comparison)
Editable parameter tags allowing user refinement before final recommendation generation

application_workflow_steps.name: Ranked IS Standards Recommendations
components: Ranked Recommendation List with Relevance Confidence % (e.g., IS 2062:2011 - 98% Match)
Standard Status Pill (🟢 Current / 🟡 Under Revision / 🔴 Withdrawn)
Why Recommended summary statement
Expandable Clause Evidence Accordion (exact text alignment from IS document)
Action Buttons: View Full IS Spec, Perform Gap Analysis, Bookmark for Tender Brief

application_workflow_steps.name: Full IS Standard Detailed View
components: Standard Header: IS Code, Title, Technical Committee (e.g., MTD 04 Steel Specifications), Year of Last Reaffirmation
Tabs: Scope & Definitions, Mandatory Clauses & Tolerances, Required Test Methods & Sampling, Amendments & Superseded Standards, Cross-Referenced IS Standards
Download Official BIS Specification Reference link & Copy Clause Reference tools

application_workflow_steps.name: MANAK Insight & Gap Analysis
components: Compliance Risk Radar & Score (e.g., 85/100 Compliance Readiness)
Missing Technical Parameters Matrix (e.g. 'Tender omitted Yield Stress tolerance under IS 2062 Class E410')
Ambiguity Warning Flags in Tender Drafting
AI Specification Enhancement Suggestions (exact text to paste into GeM or Tender Document to ensure quality compliance)

application_workflow_steps.name: Procurement Analysis History Log
components: Searchable & Filterable Table (by Date, Sector, Department, Standards Count)
Quick Replay & Comparison View
Export Analysis Brief as PDF / Printable Tender Specification Appendix
Delete / Archive records option

application_workflow_steps.name: Tender Brief Export & Model Transparency
components: Printable/PDF Tender Specification Brief Modal containing BIS-certified language
MANAK AI Model Scope & Transparency Panel: Dataset coverage (22,000+ IS standards), Vector embeddings info, Limitations, Official BIS disclaimer

layout_and_spacing.grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid for Analytics + Swiss Structural Layout for Reading
layout_and_spacing.card_styling: bg-white border border-[#E5DFD5] rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200
layout_and_spacing.guilloche_overlay_rule: Use guilloche pattern asset with pointer-events-none opacity-5 or opacity-10 on main container backgrounds and modal header banners.

testing_and_qa.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, input fields, cards, badges, and metrics MUST include data-testid with role-based kebab-case naming (e.g. data-testid='new-requirement-submit-button', data-testid='is-standard-card-2062', data-testid='gap-analysis-tab').
testing_and_qa.js_file_format: All frontend components must be standard React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files located in src/components/ and src/pages/.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a rich, fully responsive, interactive single-page app with tab/workflow switching or router navigation connecting all required steps: Landing -> Dashboard -> New Requirement -> Progress -> Requirement Analysis -> Recommended Standards -> Standard Detail -> MANAK Insight / Gap Analysis -> History.
Ensure pre-loaded sample procurement documents are available for 1-click testing so judges/users do not need to type long text.
Include high-fidelity PDF export simulation and printable tender brief generator with official BIS design header styling.
Integrate guilloche background pattern cleanly without distorting readability.
Strictly follow the color palette (BIS Manak Red #B81D24, Deep Navy #0B132B, Warm Off-White #FAF8F5).
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive components for test verification.
